scripts.postinstall: cd front-end && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../back-end && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.install:all: cd front-end && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../back-end && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build: cd front-end && npm run build && cd ../back-end && npm run build
scripts.start: cd back-end && node dist/main.js & cd front-end && npm run start
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd back-end && npm run start:dev" "cd front-end && npm run dev"
